name: Dispatch Guard
description: Middleware that enforces an orchestrator agent's output routing at the tool seam: denies deliverable writes outside a whitelist, warns on shell commands that produce deliverables, and backstops a disabled spawn_subagent

description_i18n.zh-CN: 在工具接缝层强制编排 agent 的产出路由：白名单外的交付物写入直接拒绝并提示派发给对应 agent，shell 交付物启发式仅警告，spawn_subagent 兜底拦截
description_i18n.en-US: Enforces an orchestrator agent's output routing at the tool seam: deny deliverable writes outside the whitelist, warn-only shell heuristics, spawn backstop

author: leo

meta.notes: No agent-facing tools. Configuration lives in routes.json next to plugin.json: mode (enforce|warn|off, hot-reloaded by mtime), routes (keyword -> agent), ext_routes (extension -> agent). Interception log: <workspace>/logs/dispatch_guard.jsonl
